label: serves as outrider and licensing officer
notes: She believes salt law is the only reason the plain has not eaten everyone on it, and she is not wrong. What she fears is an order she cannot square with the statute she believes in, which is exactly what chapter 5 hands her. The Wardenry is not an institution to her, it is the two hundred dead at Sixty Wells, and she will invoke the Fourth Article meaning every word of it.
